display.title: Episode 402: Little Avraham (Parshas Lech Lecha)
display.summary_short: For Parshas Lech Lecha: how Hashem showed Avraham Avinu the stars of heaven, why every child is a star that lights up the world, and how little Avraham discovered Hashem.
display.summary_long: Broadcast the week of Parshas Lech Lecha 5750. Uncle Yossi tells how Hashem promised Avraham Avinu children as numerous as the stars, and, following Rashi, took him above the heavens to see all the stars at once, with no spaceship needed, because Hashem controls nature. Like stars, every soldier in Tzivos Hashem brings light to a dark world through Torah and mitzvos, until Moshiach comes and a new light shines from Tzion. After the Hakochainik march, a whole family of children leads the Shema in Studio 604, and their father gives the listeners a brachah. Story time tells of three-year-old Avraham walking by the sea and wondering who made the world. He thinks the sun might be the Creator, then the moon, then the stars, but each one sets and disappears. Finally he understands that the one Creator, unseen and everywhere, made them all, and he wants to tell the whole world. The mailbox brings a sweet letter from a five-year-old listener, and the show ends with Shabbos candle times after the clocks were turned back.
display.lesson: Like the stars, each of us lights up the world with Torah and mitzvos, and like Avraham we can find Hashem by thinking about His world.
